---
title: "Shortener on Start + Void"
description: "Native Shortener runtime, emitted-Worker qualification, and the held cutover and rollback runbook."
updatedAt: "2026-10-31"
audience: developers
---

Shortener (`apps/shortener`) is the first Wave 2 Vercel exit. Its source runs on
TanStack Start, Vite+ and the official Void SDK with a custom Worker entry
(`cloudflare/worker.ts`). Production publication is **held for wave-2 cutover**
by `productionPublicationPolicy` in `tuturuuu.ci.ts`: the legacy
`vercel-production-shortener.yaml` publisher reports the hold and never deploys,
and the canonical domains keep serving the last Vercel deployment. **Held** is
not delivery, and no staging publisher exists yet.

Its request context, `next/headers`/`next/server` ports, Vite preset and central
API forwarding come from [`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`](/build/devops/start-bridge);
the app keeps only its Worker router, page model and API guard. CI runs
`start-bridge-routes check apps/shortener` (Shortener has no App Router source).

## Request ownership

The Worker owns the request policy before Start runs:

| Request | Owner and behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Any of the seven production hosts | Fenced with `503 Staging gateway only` unless `SHORTENER_CANONICAL_HOST_ENABLED=1`. |
| `www.ttr.gg` | `308` to `https://ttr.gg` with the same path and raw query. |
| `shortener.tuturuuu.com`, `tuturuu.com`, `www.tuturuu.com`, `tutur3u.com`, `www.tutur3u.com` | `307` to `https://ttr.gg` with the same path and raw query. |
| `/api/build-info` | Local build identity (`GET`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`). |
| `/api`, `/api/*` | The retained `proxy:shortener:api` abuse guard runs first. |
| `/api/verify` | Local password verification (`POST`; `OPTIONS` returns `204`). |
| Other `/api/*` | Forwarded to `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`) with the raw query, body, cookies and every `Set-Cookie`. |
| `/assets/*` and the eight `public/` files | Static assets; they win over a same-named slug. |
| `/` | `307` to `SHORTENER_HOME_URL` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`). |
| `/{slug}/` | `308` to `/{slug}` with the raw query. |
| `/{slug}` | Exact, case-sensitive lookup; see [Shortener](/platform/applications/shortener) for the result rules. |
| Deeper paths | Start renders the not-found page with `404`. |
| Other document methods | `405` with `Allow: GET, HEAD`. |

Every response carries `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, nosnippet`,
`X-Frame-Options: DENY` and `frame-ancestors 'none'`, matching the retained
Next configuration. Documents use the dynamic `private, no-cache, no-store`
cache policy, so a CDN never caches a redirect target.

Domain logic lives in framework-free modules under `src/link/` with an injected
store; `src/native/supabase-store.server.ts` is the service-role adapter and
`src/native/shortener-request.ts` is the injectable request policy. Start only
renders the password, not-found and invalid-destination pages from the model the
Worker resolved. A direct server-function call has no resolved slug and receives
the not-found model, so it never discloses a destination.

## Local verification

Run focused tests through the resource queue:

```bash
ttr resources run -- bun --cwd apps/shortener run test
ttr resources run -- node --test scripts/ci/production-publication-policy.test.js
python3 scripts/ci/shortener-native-artifact.test.py
```

`bun run dev` serves the Worker through Void's dev server. Do not run
`build:cloudflare` locally; CI builds the exact commit.

## CI qualification

`shortener-cloudflare.yaml` runs on pull requests and `main` pushes for the
Shortener closure. It builds the native Start SSR output with Void, rejects
route-tree drift, type-checks, discovers the single emitted Wrangler config and
checks the staging identity, static output and binding types, and dry-runs
Wrangler without publication. It seals the output with
`shortener-native-artifact.py`, which reuses the reviewed Apps seal and restore
implementation with Shortener's identity and public files.

Like Apps, Shortener's Wrangler use is admitted in
`scripts/ci/wrangler-usage-allowlist.json` under the `void-wave1-publication`
gap: Void rebuilds on deploy, so CI qualifies the exact emitted Worker with the
pinned Wrangler adapter. The entries are removed with the Apps gap once
`cf deploy --prebuilt` publication of a Void build is proven byte-identical.

`cloudflare/native-built-worker.test.mjs` starts a copy of the emitted artifact
in workerd. Every subrequest goes to the in-process fence in
`cloudflare/native-fixture.mjs`, which stands in for Supabase REST and the central
API; any other egress fails the test. It covers:

- build identity at the exact source SHA
- `307` redirects for generated slugs and custom aliases, with one click row each
- the production-host fence
- SSR of the not-found, invalid-destination and password pages, without the
  destination or secrets and with loadable client scripts
- local `bcryptjs` verification (`400`, `403`, `404`, `405`, `413`, and `401`
  for an invalid app bearer)
- central forwarding with a raw duplicate query and multiple `Set-Cookie` headers

A clean `restore-acceptance` job restores the archive without rebuilding,
dry-runs Wrangler again, repeats the same workerd suite, and verifies that the
hashes are unchanged.

## Cutover and rollback runbook

Apply the shared sequence in Wave-1 native cutover
with this Shortener profile. Do not switch traffic with an unfilled release record.

### Before cutover

1. **Release record.** Capture the exact accepted `main` SHA, the green
   `shortener-cloudflare.yaml` run and artifact hash, the account/zone/Worker
   identity, secret **names** (`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`,
   `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`,
   `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`), the immutable Vercel deployment ID/URL,
   operator and rollback owner.
2. **Domains.** Export all seven Vercel domain mappings and redirect statuses
   (`shortener.tuturuuu.com`, `tuturuu.com`, `www.tuturuu.com`, `tutur3u.com`,
   `www.tutur3u.com`, `www.ttr.gg`, `ttr.gg`), with DNS records and TTLs. Vercel
   reports no explicit status for `tuturuu.com` and `tutur3u.com`, so the Worker
   uses Vercel's `307` default. Confirm the observed status before cutover and
   update `src/link/hosts.ts` if it differs.
3. **Baseline capture.** From an allowlisted probe (Vercel bot protection answers
   anonymous probes with `429`), record the live status, `Location` and cache
   headers for `/`, an existing slug, a custom alias, a password link, a
   missing slug and one alias host. Use a dedicated test link so analytics stay
   clean. The legacy streamed page may answer an existing slug with `200` and a
   client redirect; the native Worker always answers `307`.
4. **Admission.** Admit Shortener with `surfaces: ['frontend']` in a reviewed
   cutover PR only after a staging publisher following the Wave-1 pattern has
   produced hosted acceptance. Leave `SHORTENER_CANONICAL_HOST_ENABLED` unset
   until the switch.

### Acceptance on the hosted candidate

Check each of these before the switch:

- existing generated slugs and custom aliases redirect to their stored targets
  with `307`
- raw duplicate query keys survive alias-host redirects and API forwarding
- password links: a wrong password returns `403`, the right one navigates and
  records one click
- an invalid stored target shows the invalid-destination page, and a missing
  slug shows not found
- the API abuse guard rejects oversized bodies and invalid app bearers
- click rows carry Cloudflare geolocation, and `vercel_region` and `vercel_id`
  are null

### Switch

Prefer a pre-staged, proxied Cloudflare route in front of the still-valid Vercel
origin, so removing the route restores Vercel at the same hostname. Switch only
the Shortener hosts. Enable `SHORTENER_CANONICAL_HOST_ENABLED=1` on the admitted
production Worker in the same change. Verify `/api/build-info` on `ttr.gg`, a
test-link redirect, an alias-host redirect and the error rate against the
baseline.

### Rollback

- **Triggers:** any wrong redirect target, an open redirect, a disclosed
  password-protected target, or analytics privacy failure triggers an immediate
  rollback. So does sustained 5xx above 1% or p95 above twice the baseline for
  5 minutes, once the operator agrees thresholds.
- **Action:** remove or repoint only the prepared Worker route, or restore the
  captured mappings and DNS for all seven domains and the immutable Vercel
  deployment. Never rebuild on the rollback path. Target ≤5 minutes after the
  decision, and record the actual time.
- **Data:** route rollback never rewrites `shortened_links` targets or slugs.
  Click rows written by the Worker remain; never delete or replay them.
- **Stability:** keep the Vercel project, domains and credentials for **14
  consecutive stable days**; any material regression resets the clock.
  Decommissioning Vercel is a separate approval.
